name: Bordalba (Spain)
description: Red field with a white cross throughout, charged with yellow fleurs-de-lis at the upper hoist and lower fly and yellow castles at the upper fly and lower hoist.
history: Municipal flag of Bordalba; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: fleurs-de-lis in the upper hoist and lower fly quarters
castles in the upper fly and lower hoist quarters
